newsitem.title: ITALY: TENNIS-BECKER PULLS OUT OF MILAN TOURNAMENT.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-BECKER PULLS OUT OF MILAN TOURNAMENT.

text.p: Boris Becker has pulled out of the Milan indoor tennis tournament because of an injured wrist, organisers said on Monday.
They said Becker informed the $815,000 tournament on Sunday that he had decided to withdraw because of a persistent problem with his right wrist.
Becker last week pulled out of the European Community championship in Antwerp, Belgium, because of tendinitis in his wrist.
The German former world number one has said he has been told by doctors that the problem originated from a pinched nerve in his neck.
The Milan tournament, which began on Monday, has been hit by a wave of withdrawals by leading players because of injuries and illness.

Six others players pulled out earlier -- Swedes Thomas Enqvist and Magnus Gustafsson, Russian Yevgeny Kafelnikov, Italian Renzo Furlan, Dutchman Jan Siemerink and German Hendrik Dreekmann, an ATP spokeswoman said in Antwerp last week.
She said Enqvist and Siemerink had leg injuries, Gustafsson a shoulder problem, Kafelnikov a hand injury and Dreekmann a wrist problem. Furlan is ill.
